Commit every MOVE/DOWN/UP intention through the existing parent-owned ledger.
Observe current pressed state with bounded polling before UP, and recheck after parent ACK.
Report queued requests and queued cancellation separately from execution or delivery acknowledgement.
No text input, draft clearing, screen-reader settings, navigation, encoding probes, retries or fallback.

Separate opt-in complete-sequence trial: precommit all effect intents, fresh full preflight, native binding checks during MOVE/DOWN/settle/UP, strict postflight; no intermediate pressed polling or UIA roundtrips. Default and original polled candidate remain unchanged.
